PLAN "Prenatal Strength Maintenance (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and stability through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Alignment" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
